title.en: Convert kitchen units, and see that volume to mass needs a density

goal.en: Kitchen units have exact metric values in the standard (a tablespoon is 15 ml, a cup 240 ml). Converting a volume to a mass requires a density; without one the tool answers an error, never a guess.

note.en: Two tablespoons of oil in millilitres.
One cup of flour in grams, with the density of flour given as 0.53 g/ml.
Half a kilogram, the other way round.

cli: cookwala convert 1 cup g   # error: volume<->mass conversion needs a density

outcome.en: You can scale and convert the quantities in a recipe. Asking for a cup in grams without a density returns an HTTP 400 problem, which is the standard refusing to guess. Next: scenario 019 converts quantities read from a recipe document.
